\noindent{\footnotesize{Zero-shot: the checkpoints of Table~\ref{tab:internal} are applied to MLD24 without any training, fine-tuning or target-domain statistic. \#$_{\mathrm{int}}$ repeats the rank of the same model on the internal test partition. $\Delta$acc.\ is the accuracy lost between the two partitions (smaller is better). Because MLD24 covers 6 of our 21 labels, the label space is unchanged at inference and the 15 unrepresented classes remain available as false-positive sinks; because the six covered classes are equally sized (800 images each), accuracy, balanced accuracy and macro-recall coincide. G-mean is the geometric mean of the six per-class recalls: a single class at zero recall drives it to $\approx$0.008, so the column is a direct witness of the single-class collapse discussed in Section~\ref{sec:res-perclass}.}}
